kitPage.faq1Q: How many photos can I put on the {kit} jersey?
kitPage.faq1A: One to three. They stack vertically inside the number, in the order you add them. Three photos give the richest result on a wide digit.
kitPage.faq2Q: Do my photos need a particular background?
kitPage.faq2A: No. Photos are used whole and clipped by the shape of the digit, so your background becomes part of the design. A bright, sharp photo with the subject centred works best.
kitPage.faq3Q: How long does it take and how do I pay?
kitPage.faq3A: Your order is recorded immediately with its preview. Payment is by bank transfer or finalised over WhatsApp: we confirm every order by hand before production starts.
